name: What should I do first if my log home interior looks faded or blotchy?
description: Start with an inspection and cleaning plan. Faded, blotchy interiors usually need prep work before any new stain is applied.

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if my log home interior looks faded or blotchy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first step is usually an inspection of the logs, trim, ceilings, and any problem spots, followed by cleaning and surface prep. A proper interior staining job should include checking for uneven color, prior coatings, and areas that may need sanding or repair before finish is applied.
